meta.title: One car, two roommates
meta.prompt: Two roommates share a single car. One needs it for work tomorrow, while the other needs it for an appointment. Neither has specified their timing, locations, travel durations, or scheduling flexibility. Can you help them identify the necessary information, resolve potential conflicts, and agree on a feasible schedule?
meta.context: Jordan and Riley share one car. Places: home, office, clinic. Drive times (minutes): home-office 25, home-clinic 15, office-clinic 20. The bus runs home-office only (55 minutes). A rideshare home-clinic costs $18 each way.

events.text: Hi Jordan and Riley — to build a schedule that gets you both where you need to go with one car, I need a couple of details. What time does Jordan need to be at the office tomorrow, and what time is Riley's appointment at the clinic? Also, do you both need to get back home later in the day, and is there a preferred driver for the car? Once I have those times I can map out the car/bus/rideshare options.
I have a physical therapy appointment at the clinic tomorrow from 10:00 to 11:00, and I'd really prefer not to take a rideshare if possible.

Thanks Riley, 10:00-11:00 at the clinic noted and I’ll avoid rideshare if we can make it work with the car. Jordan, what time do you need to be at the office tomorrow, and do you need to get back home later in the day? Riley, do you need to get back home after your 11:00 appointment, or are you done for the day? Also, is there a preferred driver for the car tomorrow? With Jordan’s start time and your both return needs I can map the car/bus options that get you both there with one car.
I need to be at the office by 08:30 and I do need to get back home later, my usual time is 5:30 pm but I can leave as early as 5:00 pm if needed. I'd rather not take the bus if possible.

Here’s a one-car option that avoids bus and rideshare for both of you: Morning • 08:05-08:30 Riley drives Jordan home → office. Jordan is at the office by 08:30. • 08:30-08:55 Riley drives office → home alone, bringing the car back. • 09:45-10:00 Riley drives home → clinic. Riley is at the clinic for the 10:00-11:00 appointment. Midday • 11:00-11:15 Riley drives clinic → home. Car is back at home. Afternoon pickup • 16:35-17:00 Riley drives home → office. • 17:00-17:25 Riley drives office → home with Jordan. Jordan gets home ~17:25, within your 17:00-17:30 window. No bus and no rideshare is used, Riley drives all car legs, and the car is always where its driver starts. Does this work for you both?
This plan works for me, I can drive Jordan to the office and then head to my appointment without taking a rideshare or the bus, which I prefer.

Riley, thanks for confirming you can drive Jordan to the office and then get to your 10:00-11:00 clinic appointment without bus or rideshare. Jordan, can you confirm this works for you? You’d be driven home → office by Riley at 08:05 arriving 08:30, and picked up at the office at 17:00 arriving home ~17:25, which is within your 17:00-17:30 window and avoids the bus. Let me know if you’d like any tweaks.
This plan works for me, I'll arrive at the office on time and get back home within my preferred window without having to take the bus.

violations.fact: is at office, not home, when the 16:35 leg starts
